basic_details.job_title: AMU CPC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.application_mode: Online at the Careers Portal, then hard copy by post
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit.

qualification.details: Applications are invited from Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the application form. The relaxation in the percentage of marks will be given as per the rule of the Government of India, wherever applicable. The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum; possessing them does not by itself entitle an applicant to be called for interview. Two years of professional experience after acquiring the Master's degree is required; professional experience means the experience approved by the Board of Studies. Experience certificates must be enclosed wherever applicable. | Candidates should check the official notification for the exact field-wise eligibility of the post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Fixed salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month

how_to_apply: The application has two stages: an online form on the University's Careers Portal (careers.amuonline.ac.in) and a signed hard copy sent by post. Applicants must follow the instructions in the advertisement and the User Manual available on the Careers Portal.
Fill in the application form only in online mode on the Careers Portal of the University, by 28 November 2026.
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- per application form, only in online mode on the Careers Portal.
After successful submission, take a printout of the PDF file of the application form on A-4 size paper.
Sign the printout and paste a recent front-facing photograph at the designated place.
Attach self-attested copies of all the relevant documents listed below.
On the top-left side of the cover, write the post applied for, the advertisement number and its date.
Send the complete application by post to the Office of the Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002, so that it reaches by 5 December 2026.
A separate application form is to be filled for each post detailed under a different serial number of the advertisement.
The fee is paid only in online mode at the Careers Portal.

The University may constitute a committee to scrutinise the applications and short-list the applicants, and it reserves the right to restrict the number of applicants called for interview on the basis of rules, criteria or any other condition it deems fit. The list of eligible candidates for interview will be displayed on the webpage of the Centre of Professional Courses, AMU, and no separate interview letter will be issued. The interview is on 12 December 2026; the notice does not give the interview time or venue. Candidates called for interview will not be paid TA/DA.

rows.fields: Finance, International Business, T.T. Mgt., Marketing

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the application form. The relaxation in the percentage of marks will be given as per the rule of the Government of India, wherever applicable. The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum; possessing them does not by itself entitle an applicant to be called for interview. Two years of professional experience after acquiring the Master's degree is required; professional experience means the experience approved by the Board of Studies. Experience certificates must be enclosed wherever applicable. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact field-wise eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline and Master's Degree in Business Administration with specialization preferably in Finance / International Business / T.T. Management / Marketing or PGDM / M.Com with First class or equivalent and two years of professional experience after acquiring the Master's degree. Professional experience means the experience approved by the Board of Studies.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: a fixed salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month. The notice does not mention any allowances. Tenure: the appointment will be purely temporary till the end of academic session 2026-2027. The appointment is liable to be terminated at any time without any notice or assignment of reason(s). The number of posts and the salary may be varied at the time of interview. The University reserves the right to get selected applicants examined by an Internal Medical Board.

content_sections.heading: AMU CPC Assistant Professors Job Description
content_sections.text: To teach the students of "P.G. & UG level academic programs of multiple durations" run by the Centre of Professional Courses, A.M.U., Aligarh, for the Academic Session 2026-2027.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AMU CPC Assistant Professors
content_sections.text: The fee is paid only in online mode at the Careers Portal. The University may constitute a committee to scrutinise the applications and short-list the applicants, and it reserves the right to restrict the number of applicants called for interview on the basis of rules, criteria or any other condition it deems fit. The list of eligible candidates for interview will be displayed on the webpage of the Centre of Professional Courses, AMU, and no separate interview letter will be issued. The interview is on 12 December 2026; the notice does not give the interview time or venue. Candidates called for interview will not be paid TA/DA.

rows.fee: Exempted, in case they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma with the application form

Last date for hard copy in the office of the Director

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of these documents are mandatory with the application form; without them the form will be summarily rejected: High School and Intermediate / Senior Secondary School Certificate from a Recognized Board Mark-sheet and Degree of Graduation Mark-sheet and Degree of Post-Graduation Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc. as the case may be M.Phil / Ph.D. Degree wherever applicable Experience Certificates wherever applicable Printout of the online application form, signed, with a recent front-facing photograph pasted Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (PwD candidates claiming fee exemption, uploaded with the online form)

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor vacancies are there in AMU CPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 Assistant Professor posts in the fields of Finance, International Business, T.T. Mgt. and Marketing at the Centre of Professional Courses, AMU.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AMU CPC Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The online application form must be submitted by 28 November 2026, and the hard copy must reach the office of the Centre by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for AMU CPC Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline and a Master's Degree in Business Administration with specialization preferably in Finance / International Business / T.T. Management / Marketing, or PGDM / M.Com, with First class or equivalent, and two years of professional experience after acquiring the Master's degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of AMU CPC Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The posts carry a fixed salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month, which may be varied at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable processing fee is Rs. 500/- per application form, paid online at the Careers Portal; PwD candidates are exempted if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the AMU CPC Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Fill the form online on the AMU Careers Portal, then send the signed printout with photograph and self-attested documents by post to the Office of the Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications may be scrutinised and short-listed by a committee, and the list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the Centre's webpage for the interview on 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the AMU CPC Assistant Professor job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary till the end of academic session 2026-2027 and is liable to be terminated at any time without notice or assignment of reasons.

faq.question: Q9. Will an interview letter be sent or TA/DA paid?
faq.answer: No separate interview letter will be issued, and candidates called for interview will not be paid TA/DA.

faq.question: Q10. Can OCI Cardholders apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applications are invited from Indian nationals including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955.
